privileged_info_for_vlm: The target orbit is a 550km altitude Sun-Synchronous Orbit (SSO). Valid SMA (Semi-Major Axis) should be between 6880.0 and 6970.0 km (Earth radius ~6378km + 550km). Eccentricity (ECC) must be less than 0.015 for a stable circular orbit. Inclination (INC) for a 550km SSO must be between 97.0 and 99.5 degrees. The report must be at /home/ga/GMAT_output/leo_diagnosis_report.txt and contain the exact labels specified.
